### Summary

Most numerical choices of a run are made in its YAML card: the gravity-work form, the equation of state and its
floors, the reconstruction, the Riemann solver, the implicit scheme, the geometry, the block decomposition and the
boundary faces. This section lists those keys with their defaults, and the combinations the solver refuses because
they would silently change what it computes or conserves. Every key the parsers accept, with its default and the section that
explains it, is listed in @sec-appi.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** Selects schemes and rejects incompatible configurations.

**Data.** YAML blocks in; component options and setup guards out.

**Placement.** Parse recognized keys, then validate again during hydro reset.

**Activation.** Defaults include face work, Cartesian geometry and one ghost cell.

**Guarantee / limits.** Refuses non-cell work with a nonzero-gravity fixer, a fixer with lateral gravity, a fixer with periodic $x_1$, and implicit CFL[^rg-a6d2f00b5dc7] keys without an implicit scheme; recognized keys alone do not guarantee compatibility.

**Evidence.** Tests below, @tbl-ch12-yaml-tests; solver ctests were not run.
:::

| key | default | coupling |
|---|---|---|
| `forcing/const-gravity/gravity-work` | `face` | `cell`, `face-wallc` or `face`; selects the budget the solver conserves |
| `gravity-work-fixer` in that block | true for `cell`, false otherwise | with nonzero `grav1` it needs `cell`; the reset clears it for non-cell work and needs `grav2` = `grav3` = 0 and non-periodic $x_1$ |
| `grav1`, `grav2`, `grav3` | 0 | the gravity components |
| `non-hydrostatic`[^rg-5e19433b0f93] | 1 | must lie in $[0,1]$ |
| `dynamics/wb-wall-clamp` | true | required by `balance_column` |
| `dynamics/disable-flux-x1`, `-x2`, `-x3`, `verbose` | false | flux and source direction gates |
| `dynamics/conversion-order` | 2 | 2 or 4, anything else refused; 4 is the fourth-order $x_1$ cell-average to point conversion of @sec-ch04-conv4, and with nonzero `grav1` it needs `nghost` $\ge 3$ and the fourth-order face density reference of @sec-ch05-wbref4 |
| `dynamics/equation-of-state/type` | `moist-mixture` | `shallow-water` bypasses the radial well-balanced path |
| EOS `limiter`[^rg-98ec00569918] | false | positivity correction |
| EOS density, pressure and temperature floors | $10^{-6}\ \mathrm{kg\,m^{-3}}$, $10^{-3}\ \mathrm{Pa}$, $20\ \mathrm{K}$ | state floors |
| reconstruction `vertical`[^rg-5b49f4848d58]/`horizontal`[^rg-2f1899b4de4d] `type`, `scale`[^rg-d97ad30fbd10], `shock`[^rg-ff2904b92111] | `dc`, false, false | spatial reconstruction |
| `dynamics/riemann-solver/type`, `dir`[^rg-c2a5d0bf48c0] | `roe`, `omni` | interface flux solver |
| `integration/implicit-scheme` | absent, no implicit module | 0 (none), 1 (`vic-partial`) or 9 (`vic-full`); anything else is refused |
| `implicit-advection-cfl`[^rg-b91f3c2b82ba], `shear-cfl`[^rg-1d58aa505896] | 1, 0 | refused without an implicit scheme; must be finite, positive and nonnegative |
| `geometry/cells/nghost` | 1 | WB or XC with gravity need at least 3 |
| `geometry/type` | `cartesian` | gates XC and the corrected-work measure |
| `distribute/layout`, `nb1`, `nb2`, `nb3` | `slab`, 1, 1, 1 | block decomposition; `backend` is accepted and ignored |
| external boundaries `x1-inner`[^rg-6190053d30cd] ... `x3-outer`[^rg-4a2bbc8a9e41] | `reflecting` | a periodic $x_1$ is refused with an active fixer |
| `forcing/fric-heat` | removed | an explicit parse error |

: YAML keys and defaults at the pin. {#tbl-ch12-yaml-keys}

### Derivation

No separate continuum equation is introduced by the parser; the configuration resolves into the schemes of
the preceding sections and of @sec-ch04 to @sec-ch07. Changing the gravity-work mode changes the budget the
solver conserves (@sec-ch06-dwork), not an output label, so validation is part of the numerical contract:
incompatible options must not run silently. Check line `[C10]` holds both halves: over ten option pairs the
validator rejects exactly the two marked incompatible and accepts the rest, and the corrected budget functional
differs from the plain one symbolically, agreeing only for a constant density
[check `src/snapy_report/ch12/checks/configuration_check.py`, output
`src/snapy_report/ch12/checks/configuration_check.out`].

### Numerical method

The parsers read their blocks with a key check: `HydroOptionsImpl::from_yaml`
({{< code src/hydro/hydro_options.cpp HydroOptionsImpl::from_yaml >}}) for `dynamics` and `forcing`, refusing
`fric-heat`; `ConstGravityOptionsImpl::from_yaml` ({{< code src/forcing/const_gravity.cpp ConstGravityOptionsImpl::from_yaml >}})
for the gravity block, with the `face` default and the fixer check; `ImplicitOptionsImpl::from_yaml`
({{< code src/implicit/implicit_hydro.cpp ImplicitOptionsImpl::from_yaml overload=1 >}}) for `integration`[^rg-1f42b5e0e193], which
returns no implicit module when the scheme key is absent or 0, refuses the CFL keys without a scheme, and names
the scheme through its second overload ({{< code src/implicit/implicit_hydro.cpp ImplicitOptionsImpl::from_yaml overload=2 >}});
`EquationOfStateOptionsImpl::from_yaml` ({{< code src/eos/equation_of_state.cpp EquationOfStateOptionsImpl::from_yaml >}});
`ReconstructOptionsImpl::from_yaml` ({{< code src/recon/reconstruct.cpp ReconstructOptionsImpl::from_yaml overload=2 >}});
`RiemannSolverOptionsImpl::from_yaml` ({{< code src/riemann/riemann_solver.cpp RiemannSolverOptionsImpl::from_yaml overload=2 >}});
`CoordinateOptionsImpl::from_yaml` ({{< code src/coord/coordinate.cpp CoordinateOptionsImpl::from_yaml >}});
`LayoutOptionsImpl::from_yaml` ({{< code src/layout/layout.cpp LayoutOptionsImpl::from_yaml >}}); and
`MeshBlockOptionsImpl::from_yaml` ({{< code src/mesh/meshblock_options.cpp MeshBlockOptionsImpl::from_yaml >}})
for the boundaries (@sec-ch11-registry). `HydroImpl::reset` ({{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::reset >}})
then re-checks the gravity-work constraints for options built directly: it clears the fixer for non-cell work,
refuses a fixer with lateral gravity or a periodic $x_1$, applies the ghost and cell guards of the numerics
switches, and warns when implicit non-cell work has no in-operator path.

### Code

**How to use it.** Add this gravity block to a complete input card to select plain cell work with its fixer:

```yaml
forcing:
  const-gravity:
    grav1: -9.8     # m s^-2
    gravity-work: cell
    gravity-work-fixer: true
```

Keep radial boundaries non-periodic and lateral gravity zero for this fixer. Changing only the work mode to
`face` makes the parser refuse the nonzero-gravity combination with
"forcing/const-gravity/gravity-work-fixer needs gravity-work: cell".
For face work, set the fixer false and choose RE according to the intended budget (@sec-ch12-radial-exact).
Unknown keys are refused by each component's key check; recognized keys still pass through reset's guards.

`ConstGravityOptionsImpl::from_yaml` ({{< code src/forcing/const_gravity.cpp ConstGravityOptionsImpl::from_yaml >}}) contains this selection step:

```cpp
  bool cell = op->gravity_work() == "cell";
  op->gravity_work_fixer() = node["gravity-work-fixer"].as<bool>(cell);
  if (op->gravity_work_fixer() && op->grav1() != 0.) {
    TORCH_CHECK(cell,
                "forcing/const-gravity/gravity-work-fixer needs gravity-work: "
                "cell");
  }
```

The boolean `cell` supplies the fixer default and the admissibility condition. `[C10]` checks the logical
accept/reject distinction and the symbolic budget difference; actual parser errors belong to the CTest assertions.

: Implementation sites for the YAML selection. {#tbl-ch12-yaml-code}

1. Parse the recognized blocks, each with its key check, and instantiate the component options. The anchor
   `check_keys` is in {{< code src/hydro/hydro_options.cpp HydroOptionsImpl::from_yaml >}}.
2. Refuse a fixer with non-cell work at parse time. The anchor `gravity_work` is in
   {{< code src/forcing/const_gravity.cpp ConstGravityOptionsImpl::from_yaml >}}.
3. Reset the hydro module: normalize the fixer, apply the remaining guards, warn on implicit non-cell work
   without an operator path. The anchor `gravity_work_fixer` is in
   {{< code src/hydro/hydro.cpp HydroImpl::reset >}}.

**Porting a deck from Athena++.** snapy has no converter and reads no Athena++ input file; it reads only YAML, so a
deck is translated by hand, block by block. The mesh block (`nx1`..`nx3`[^rg-57ef49c68231], `x1min`[^rg-57b3ad867168]..`x3max`[^rg-476f85fbaeac]) becomes
`geometry/cells` and `geometry/bounds`; the boundary flags of each face (`ix1_bc`, `ox1_bc`, ...) become
`boundary-condition/external/x1-inner`, `x1-outer`[^rg-0d25664fc287], ..., with `reflecting`, `outflow` and `periodic` among the names
({{< code src/mesh/meshblock_options.cpp MeshBlockOptionsImpl::from_yaml >}}); the time block (`cfl_number`,
`tlim`[^rg-6a64ae1a6c68], `nlim`[^rg-85347293a770], `integrator`) becomes `integration/cfl`, `tlim`, `nlim` and `type`; each output block becomes one
entry of `outputs`[^rg-2470c71af444] with its `type`, `dt`[^rg-73a3f4e38361] and `variables`[^rg-c01683340b31]. Thermodynamics and species go to the blocks of
@sec-ch02-interface, and Athena++ problem-generator code has no deck equivalent: it becomes the driver's
initial-condition builder (@sec-ch01-initialization). Appendix I (@sec-appi) lists every key snapy accepts with its
default, and a key a parser does not know stops the run with "unknown key"
({{< code src/input/check_keys.cpp check_keys >}}).

### Tests

| test (ctest name) | what it asserts | tolerance | where the tolerance comes from |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_hydro_options.<b>` | `wb-wall-clamp`[^rg-ec37780980f1] ships enabled and can be turned off; unsupported implicit schemes, removed and unknown forcing keys and unknown dynamics keys are refused | exact booleans; expected exceptions | the test |
| `test_yaml_keys.<b>` | the test card loads, and every recognized block refuses an unknown key with the key's path in the message | exact string containment | the test |
| `test_implicit_options_type_python` | schemes 0, 1 and 9 name `none`, `vic-partial` and `vic-full`; scheme 5 is refused | exact strings; expected error | the script |
| `configuration_check.py` `[C10]` (report check) | the option-pair validator and budget distinction | exact symbolic or Boolean equality | the independent check |

: Source assertions, not new solver measurements. {#tbl-ch12-yaml-tests}

The hydro-options assertions are
{{< code tests/test_hydro_options.cpp hydro_options.wb_wall_clamp_ships_enabled >}},
{{< code tests/test_hydro_options.cpp hydro_options.reject_unsupported_implicit_scheme >}},
{{< code tests/test_hydro_options.cpp hydro_options.reject_removed_and_unknown_forcing_keys >}} and
{{< code tests/test_hydro_options.cpp hydro_options.reject_unknown_dynamics_keys >}}; the key-refusal helper is
`expect_refused` ({{< code tests/test_yaml_keys.cpp expect_refused overload=1 >}}) with the card test
{{< code tests/test_yaml_keys.cpp yaml_keys.the_card_itself_loads >}}; the implicit names are checked in
{{< code tests/test_implicit_options_type.py main >}}.

No snapy runtime test is executed for this chapter. CUDA and multi-rank entries describe registration only.
The independent checks and their outputs are catalogued in @sec-ch15-ch12-tests.

The independent report check verifies the option-pair validator and budget distinction in `[C10]`.[^ch12-yaml-run]
It models the stated contract; it does not execute the compiled solver.

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
Individual keys have tests, but the Cartesian product of every YAML value and study switch is not covered. Use
@sec-ch12-matrix to distinguish constrained combinations from missing numerical evidence.

The complete switch inventory is @sec-ch12-matrix.
:::

<!-- reader glossary notes -->
[^rg-a6d2f00b5dc7]: CFL — Courant–Friedrichs–Lewy

[^rg-5e19433b0f93]: non-hydrostatic — fraction of the vertical body force retained by the non-hydrostatic treatment

[^rg-98ec00569918]: limiter — whether the enclosing component enables its limiter

[^rg-5b49f4848d58]: vertical — options for the vertical reconstruction

[^rg-2f1899b4de4d]: horizontal — options for the horizontal reconstruction

[^rg-d97ad30fbd10]: scale — scaling in the enclosing component: a reconstruction switch or values of a thermal-transport profile

[^rg-ff2904b92111]: shock — whether reconstruction uses its shock handling

[^rg-c2a5d0bf48c0]: dir — direction selector for solvers that use it

[^rg-b91f3c2b82ba]: implicit-advection-cfl — Courant limit for the implicitly treated advection

[^rg-1d58aa505896]: shear-cfl — Courant limit associated with shear

[^rg-6190053d30cd]: x1-inner — boundary name on the inner first-coordinate face

[^rg-4a2bbc8a9e41]: x3-outer — boundary name on the outer third-coordinate face

[^rg-1f42b5e0e193]: integration — time-integration options

[^rg-56fbcf9e291a]: implicit-scheme — implicit time-integration scheme selector

[^rg-57ef49c68231]: nx3 — number of cells in the third coordinate direction

[^rg-57b3ad867168]: x1min — lower bound of the first coordinate

[^rg-476f85fbaeac]: x3max — upper bound of the third coordinate

[^rg-0d25664fc287]: x1-outer — boundary name on the outer first-coordinate face

[^rg-6a64ae1a6c68]: tlim — simulation end time

[^rg-85347293a770]: nlim — maximum number of integration cycles

[^rg-2470c71af444]: outputs — output-stream configuration

[^rg-73a3f4e38361]: dt — time-step duration

[^rg-c01683340b31]: variables — variables requested by an output stream

[^rg-ec37780980f1]: wb-wall-clamp — whether to clamp the well-balanced wall continuation
